pages.text: $(bold)The Guide Book$() is your companion throughout Gaia. It updates as you discover new things, unlocking pages as you progress.$(br2)Right-click to open it at any time.
$(bold)Keybinds$()$(br)Spell casting, ability activation, and other actions are bound to keys you can configure in $(italic)Options > Controls$(). Check there first if something isn't working.
